title: EntityAspectRequest
description: A request to upsert an entity-aspect pair in the DataHub metadata graph. Contains the entity URN, entity type, aspect name, and the aspect value to write.

entityUrn.description: The unique URN identifier for the entity being modified.

entityType.description: The type of the entity being modified, such as dataset, chart, dashboard, dataFlow, or dataJob.

aspectName.description: The name of the aspect being written, such as datasetProperties, schemaMetadata, ownership, or globalTags.

aspect.description: The aspect value to write. The structure varies depending on the aspect name and follows the PDL schema definitions in the DataHub metadata models.
